On `wasm32-unknown-unknown`, `std::collections::HashMap` is supported, but its default hashing is **not randomized as it is on other platforms**.[Rust platform-support documentation](https://doc.rust-lang.org/rustc/platform-support/wasm32-unknown-unknown.html)

This target does not import functions from the host, and Rust’s standard-library source selects an `unsupported` random implementation for `wasm32-unknown-unknown`.[Rust source](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/blob/d2f24127/library/std/src/sys/random/mod.rs)

Therefore, repeated executions generally have deterministic hash behavior and iteration order for the same program, although `HashMap` iteration order remains unspecified and should not be relied upon. A custom hasher can be supplied if you need explicit deterministic or randomized behavior.
